rowIssues.note: Source prints OEM B3-001-08-025-F0 beside Bolt (M8*20). Both are verbatim; verify the apparent length discrepancy against factory information.
This table records quantity 1 for Z-6000-2Z-26-10-08; 2021 Figure 17 callout 17_07 records quantity 3 for the exact same OEM. No universal quantity or interchangeability claim is inferred.
The source literally says Front Wheel Axle, OEM blank, quantity 2. Motorino Figure 17 callout 17_09 instead says Front Wheel Bearing (Φ20*Φ32*7). Neither description is silently substituted.
Source prints B3-003-05-016-F0 beside Steering Lock Mounting Screw (M5*12). Both are retained exactly for review.

notes: 282 legible physical table rows were reconciled, including one blank-callout alternate sprocket row. Five rows have blank OEM fields and one has a blank description; all are retained.
This source has 28 pages and 21 figures, ending with a one-row sticker table, not a separate bolt-summary list.

Two visible diagram-only callouts lack table rows; 13 figure image regions remain blank or clipped in the local Poppler rendering. Completeness is limited to legible source tables and does not assert exhaustive illustration or stock-BOM completeness.
PDF and rendered diagram artwork remain local reference assets and are not redistributed with the public catalog.
